## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Running the index CLI over AGENTS.md emits a JSON list of units each with id...

The system SHALL ensure that running the index CLI over AGENTS.md emits a JSON list of units each with id (AG-nnn), content hash, heading path, and line range; reordering two sections leaves every id unchanged.

#### Scenario: Running the index CLI over AGENTS.md emits a JSON list of units each with id...

WHEN `build-instruction-index-and-surface-hash` is implemented
THEN Running the index CLI over AGENTS.md emits a JSON list of units each with id (AG-nnn), content hash, heading path, and line range; reordering two sections leaves every id unchanged.

### Requirement: Editing one skill description changes the surface hash; editing README.md...

The system SHALL ensure that editing one skill description changes the surface hash; editing README.md does not (asserted by test).

#### Scenario: Editing one skill description changes the surface hash; editing README.md...

WHEN `build-instruction-index-and-surface-hash` is implemented
THEN Editing one skill description changes the surface hash; editing README.md does not (asserted by test).

### Requirement: The instruction index produced matches the ids backpass reported in the...

The system SHALL ensure that the instruction index produced matches the ids backpass reported in the ri-01 spike for the same file version, or the difference is documented.

#### Scenario: The instruction index produced matches the ids backpass reported in the...

WHEN `build-instruction-index-and-surface-hash` is implemented
THEN The instruction index produced matches the ids backpass reported in the ri-01 spike for the same file version, or the difference is documented.
